title: O Sapo não Lava o Pé

sourceProvenance.title: O Sapo Nao Lava o Pe
sourceProvenance.edition: Familiar Brazilian folklore form independently notated in G major with the short traditional chule cadence; pitch order and rhythmic contour cross-checked against the UFG academic appendix, reviewed Cifra Club tablature, and educational solfege references; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (traditional Brazilian children's song); third-party reference files are not redistributed
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.
